nervous.name: Nervous
nervous.text: Rattled by an alarm or a guard close by.
nervous.fired: {crew} is Nervous and the {tag} makes it worse.

chatty.name: Chatty
chatty.text: Cannot stay quiet when idle, which is noise.
chatty.fired: {crew} fills the silence with small talk.

perfectionist.name: Perfectionist
perfectionist.text: Slow and careful: never fails a two-beat job, but fumbles rushed one-beat ones.

overconfident.name: Overconfident
overconfident.text: Bold on jobs, useless on standby: wanders off.
overconfident.fired: {crew} was supposed to be on standby and went to look at the gift shop.

lucky.name: Lucky
lucky.text: Once per heist, a failure turns out to be a near miss.

allergic.name: Allergic
allergic.text: Loses a beat to sneezing near dust or flowers, and the sneeze is loud.
allergic.fired: {crew} is Allergic and sneezes into the {tag}.

superstitious.name: Superstitious
superstitious.text: Refuses to work on unlucky beats.
superstitious.fired: {crew} Superstitious: it is an unlucky beat, and that is that.

sentimental.name: Sentimental
sentimental.text: Pockets one small souvenir (extra cash) and leaves evidence.
sentimental.fired: {crew} Sentimental: that mug is coming along too.

cat_person.name: Cat Person
cat_person.fired: {crew} the Cat Person has seen a cat.

clumsy.name: Clumsy
clumsy.text: Everything they do is a bit louder than it should be.

calm.name: Calm
calm.text: Unflappable. When free, can talk a crowd or an alarm down.
calm.fired: {crew} is calm. It is almost rude.

show_off.name: Show-off
show_off.text: Better with an audience, great at distractions.

hoarder.name: Hoarder
hoarder.text: Grabs extra everything: a little more loot, a little more heat.
hoarder.fired: {crew} the Hoarder takes the whole box of pens.

claustrophobic.name: Claustrophobic
claustrophobic.text: Struggles in tight spaces such as vaults and cellars.

night_owl.name: Night Owl
night_owl.text: Sharper when the lights are off.
night_owl.fired: {crew} the Night Owl is in their element.

team_player.name: Team Player
team_player.text: Better when someone else is working the same beat.
team_player.fired: {crew} the Team Player works better with company.

stage_fright.name: Stage Fright
stage_fright.text: Falls apart in front of a crowd.

light_sleeper.name: Light Sleeper
light_sleeper.text: Noisy people give them the heebie-jeebies, but they hear trouble coming: absorbs noise when free.
light_sleeper.fired: {crew} the Light Sleeper noticed it first.

penny_pincher.name: Penny Pincher
penny_pincher.text: Hates waste: stashes a little extra from every job, but works for less.

motion_sick.name: Motion Sick
motion_sick.text: Wobbles on boats and in vans.
motion_sick.fired: {crew} is Motion Sick and the floor will not stay still.

pair_rules.line: {a} will not stop talking and {b} is on edge.
{a} keeps stealing the spotlight, and {b} cannot get over it.
{b} keeps bumping {a}'s elbow, and {a} has to start over in their head.
